Brief from the lead:
**Facts worker brief:** Pull these from the record exactly as stated: event type (schedule change or cancellation); itinerary type (domestic or international); minutes departure and arrival each moved; whether the traveler accepted the alternative; fare type; any medical or bereavement claim; hours since booking; days booked before departure. Flag anything missing rather than inferring it.

Record:
task E27-07
fare: nonrefundable
itinerary: international
event: schedule-change
schedule moved by: 240 minutes
traveler accepted the alternative: no
hours since booking: 400
booking was made this many days before departure: 30

State only the facts the brief asks for. At most 80 words.
